hero.title: We build the intelligence *behind* decisions that can't be taken back.
hero.line: Newron is an applied-AI company building production systems for the institutions that operate under regulation — India's banks, NBFCs, insurers and state bodies — where a wrong answer is never just a bug report.

sections.title: Some rooms don't *forgive* a guess.
sections.line: The constraint of regulated work shapes everything we make.
prose: In a credit office, an error is a mis-priced loan. In a claims queue, it's a family left waiting. At a grievance desk, it's a citizen who couldn't be heard. We would rather ship a system that says *“I'm not sure, here's the policy clause”* than one that guesses with confidence.

sections.title: Engineering, *not* magic.
sections.line: We began in Bengaluru with a narrow conviction: the distance between a frontier model and a deployable one is engineering.

steps.d: Ex-research and ex-platform engineers embed with your people to design the data pipelines, eval harnesses and inference path.
Most engagements reach production inside a single quarter — a working system you own, not a proof of concept.
VPC, on-premise or air-gapped. Compliance gets the audit trail; your engineering keeps the keys.
On the tasks we train for, our custom models score on par with frontier systems in our own evaluations, at a fraction of the inference bill.

sections.title: Already in *production*.
sections.line: Not theoretical — running today across three surfaces.

steps.d: Started with a focus on regulated industries and a conviction that deployability is an engineering problem.
Joined NVIDIA Inception, training on Indian financial data with explicit residency commitments.
Credit memos, statement analysis and verification live at banks and NBFCs.
Claims automation for insurers and citizen-service AI with the Government of Karnataka.

cta.title: Build the *defensible* kind of AI.
cta.line: Whether you want to deploy our products or have us build something custom, we'd like to hear what you're working on.
